overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Kaarina 6 Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna - 2 Tone offers a luxurious retreat for relaxation and wellness right in your backyard. Designed for outdoor use, this sauna features a robust 8.0 kW stove with built-in controls, providing a soothing heat range of 170°F-185°F, perfect for muscle relaxation and stress relief. Crafted with an all-weather exterior and a Canadian Red Cedar interior, it combines durability with a natural aesthetic. Enjoy the ambiance of a galaxy star color therapy lighting system and the convenience of an interior LED control panel with Bluetooth connectivity, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a premium, spa-like experience at home.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs all-weather exterior outdoor traditional steam sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating traditional sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Barn Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.
Golden Designs traditional saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
